rows.note: This is the all-purpose conversational choice for saying that something is tiny.
Use this colloquial form especially for a tiny solid object, often one that can be handled or counted.

example.jyutping: ni1 nap1 tong4 sai3 sai3 nap1

rows.note: Use this for a tiny person or thing when the smallness also has a little or diminutive feel.

example.english: This girl is tiny and cute.
example.traditional: 呢個女仔細細個，好得意。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 neoi5 zai2 sai3 sai3 go3 hou2 dak1 ji3

rows.note: Use this mainly in written or technical contexts for something minute, such as a detail or particle, rather than in ordinary conversation.

example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 mei4 lap1 fei1 soeng4 mei4 sai3
